label: Model and engine directory
help: Prepare the pinned 4.8 GB assets with setup_model.py first. No download occurs during a Run.

label: Inference Python executable
help: Dedicated environment containing requirements.txt. Empty uses the application's interpreter; never installed automatically.

label: Permitted audio directory
help: Completed input files must stay inside this directory. Empty uses the application root.

label: Inference device
help: CPU or the first CUDA device. Unavailable CUDA fails explicitly; no silent CPU fallback.

label: Language
help: Automatic detection or an explicit training language. No word timestamps or diarization are produced.

label: Vocabulary and context
help: Optional context for the transcription, up to 4 KiB. It is not a command or a post-transcription agent instruction.

label: Acoustic adaptation
help: Automatic routes each chunk through the base or adapted model. Always MEGA forces the official LoRA adapter.

label: Degraded-audio threshold
help: Router probability threshold for applying the MEGA adapter. Not transcription confidence.

label: Numeric precision
help: Float32 for CPU compatibility; bfloat16 reduces model memory but depends on the device.

label: CPU threads
help: Bound CPU parallelism in the owned inference process.

label: Chunk duration (seconds)
help: Longer recordings are split into contiguous chunks. Boundaries may split words; these are input spans, not word timestamps.

label: Maximum recording duration (seconds)
help: Refuse longer files instead of silently truncating them. Default: five minutes.

label: Maximum input size (bytes)
help: Bound the completed source before conversion. Default: 64 MiB.

label: Maximum generated tokens per chunk
help: A missing end-of-sequence fails the whole request instead of publishing an incomplete transcript.

label: Total request deadline (seconds)
help: Includes conversion, checksum verification, loading and every chunk. CPU inference can be slow.

label: Process address-space limit (MiB)
help: Linux virtual-memory ceiling, not a reservation or GPU-memory guarantee. Loading fails if insufficient.
